heading: Effective date
lead: The allowance under section 5622 of this title—

tree.text: shall be available beginning with the month of May 1997;
through the end of September 1997, shall be paid from the applicable accounts of the House of Representatives on a pro rata basis; and
beginning with fiscal year 1998, shall be paid as provided in appropriations Acts.

notes.text: Codification Section was formerly classified to section 74d–2 of this title prior to editorial reclassification and renumbering as this section. Section is based on section 2 of House Resolution No. 130, One Hundred Fifth Congress, Apr. 24, 1997, which was enacted into permanent law by Pub. L. 105–55.
